title: Mid Clocking
statementMd:
We have a number of processor slots in a row. The processors are each dedicated to a single task that they can complete before going into a busy-looping mode while they wait for the next instruction.

A processor can run at 100% speed if it has enough cooling, and that requires there be no adjacent processor. If a processor has 1 adjacent processor, it only runs at 60% of maximum speed. If it has 2 adjacent processors it can only run at 30% of maximum speed.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/baabb9cbb9923ffa16911a16cf8e5ad20ebc42de.png)Illustration of Sample Input 2.

We know how many seconds each task will take running on a processor at full speed, starting from t=0, and need to allocate tasks to processors to ensure the last task finishes as soon as possible.

## Input

- The number of tasks to run, n, and the number of processor slots, s (1≤n≤s≤106).
- n further integers giving the duration of each task ti in seconds if performed at 100% speed (1≤ti≤109).

## Output

Output the minimum time by which all of the tasks can be finished.

The output must be accurate to an absolute or relative error of 10−6.
